name: IKEA GRILLPLATS (EU)

radios.note: IKEA says it uses Matter over Thread. The CSA listing for family SKU E2491-EU shows Thread and Bluetooth as transports; Bluetooth is likely for Matter setup only.

matter.note: IKEA marks it Matter compatible. CSA certificate CSA255B7MAT46345-24 (Matter 1.4, certified 2025-08-20) lists family SKU E2491-EU, the type named in IKEA's German manual. CSA also has other GRILLPLATS certificates.

apple_home.note: IKEA names Apple among compatible systems. Through Matter; needs an Apple home hub that is a Thread border router.

google_home.note: IKEA names Google among compatible systems. Through Matter; needs a Google hub that is a Thread border router.

alexa.note: IKEA names Amazon among compatible systems. Through Matter; needs an Echo that is a Matter controller and Thread border router. Some buyer reviews report failed Alexa pairing.

smartthings.note: IKEA names Samsung among compatible systems. Through Matter; needs a SmartThings hub with Thread.

home_assistant.note: Through Home Assistant's Matter integration, which needs a Thread border router for Thread devices. IKEA doesn't name Home Assistant itself.

hubRequired.note: IKEA says phone control needs a Thread border router, such as its DIRIGERA hub or another ecosystem's border router. Without one it only pairs directly with an IKEA remote or motion sensor.

localControl.note: Matter-certified (CSA), and Home Assistant documents Matter as local control without cloud. IKEA itself doesn't state local control.

energyMonitoring.note: IKEA says it tracks power usage. What you see depends on the controller app.

maxLoadWatts.note: IKEA's German manual for type E2491-EU: 220-240 V, max 3680 W / 16 A resistive load, max 300 W motor load.

summary: Every route to IKEA GRILLPLATS goes through Matter over Thread. That covers Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings, which IKEA lists, plus Home Assistant's Matter integration, but each needs a Thread border router such as IKEA's DIRIGERA hub or a Thread-capable Apple, Google, Amazon or SmartThings hub. Without one, it only pairs directly with an IKEA remote or motion sensor. It tracks power use and is rated 3680 W / 16 A for resistive loads. This record covers type E2491-EU.
caveats: Needs a Thread border router (DIRIGERA or another ecosystem's) for phone, voice or ecosystem control.
Rated 3680 W / 16 A for resistive loads but only 300 W for motor loads.
Some buyer reviews report failed Alexa pairing.
What power data you see depends on the controller app.
